img/01-why-sample-exact.png.show: A close-mic hit against a triggered sample fired 1 ms late; the smeared attack is visible.

img/01-attack-aligned.png.show: The same hit with the trigger on the first sample of the attack; the two attacks line up.

img/02-add-tracks.png.show: The Add Tracks dialog with a session folder selected; the 13 tracks are listed with their roles.

img/02-inspector-role.png.show: The Inspector, section Track, with the role and the hint that says where the role came from.

img/03-detection.png.show: A snare track after the analysis; hits are marked on the wave lane and the hat bleed is left out.

img/03b-plugin-settings.png.show: The Settings sheet, Detector plug-ins group: the example plug-in with id, version, roles, licence and a Licence button.

img/03b-plugin-licence.png.show: The licence dialog before the first use: plug-in name, executable path, licence name and the full licence text.

img/04-first-sample.png.show: A hit at the 5 ms zoom; the hit line sits on the first motion of the attack in the waveform.

img/05-export.png.show: The Export dialog with the per-track MIDI and spike WAV files and the destination folder.

img/05-audio-spike.png.show: A kick hit of the demo session: the raw waveform in cobalt, the low tone below 800 Hz in orange, and the snippet range shaded up to the zero crossing.

img/06-find-your-way.png.show: A kick and a snare track at the 50 ms zoom; the playhead sits on a hit and the lanes show the neighboring tracks at their heights.

img/07-edit-hits.png.show: A snare hit selected at the 5 ms zoom; the nudge value shows 1 Sample and the hit line sits one sample to the left of the first motion.

img/08-velocity.png.show: The velocity lane under two wave lanes; the stalks follow the level of each hit and one stalk is dragged up.

img/10-bleed.png.show: A tom mic lane with a grey bleed hit, and the Other Mics Under Hit panel under the lanes: the snare mic plays louder at the hit time.

img/11-learn.png.show: The Inspector's Learn section of the snare with the Similarity histogram, the Match and Add lines and the counts line under it; the marked ghost and its near copies grey in the lane and the missed hit added.

img/09-doubtful-hits.png.show: The review queue at a doubtful hit: the playhead on the hit, the Doubt field in the info line reads 0.25: 18 dB under the track median.

img/12-followers-and-layers.png.show: A kick track and its sub mic in the Inspector; the sub mic row shows follows Kick In and the Layer section holds a one-shot with its onset line.

img/13-tempo.png.show: A session with a tempo map; the Bars|Beats ruler and the Tempo ruler sit over the lanes and the bar and beat grid runs under the hit lines.
